about: The stock sites the Modwerk base owns and turns into events (EVENTS.md). Modules subscribe; none patches these sites. events.py generates the base's dispatch, the loader's table header, the SDK header and EVENTS.md from this file. Adding an event is one reviewed entry here.

sites.routine: the playback-increment builder 0x40004008(track, ping, start, end): STATIC, FLEX and PICKUP, and POLY8's tracks through it; lea -48(sp) and 44 bytes of saved registers put its track at 52(sp) here
head: .word 0xa1c0 | movclr.l %acc0,%d0: the increment, PTCH and RATE applied
asr.l %d6,%d0
tail: move.l %d0,36(%a3) | the track state's increment, read by the source fetch and the DSP voice command

sites.routine: 0x40006820(track): stops a track's voice and binds it fresh (clears its active byte and state, then 0x4000672c), interrupts masked; 8 or more does every track by calling this site once per track. Callers: the trig path 0x4000f518, the frame handler 0x4000d45a, the renderer 0x40008110, UI paths (0x40043c50 and five more)
tail: move.l 4(%sp),%d1 | stock's own prologue, its loads in another order
done: rts | the call returns as stock's does when it has nothing to do

events.when: the increment builder recomputes a track's playback increment (Q26, 0x04000000 = unity), after stock applied PTCH and RATE and before it stores it; when the builder reuses the stored increment no handler runs
events.context: the audio render, at interrupt level: short, no firmware call that can block, the EMAC kept as found
events.contract: Change *increment to change what the track plays at. Return nonzero to take the track: no later handler runs. The base stores *increment either way. The builder's d2-d7/a2-a6 are intact in a handler (a3 the track's 40-byte state, d6 the shift just applied) and must be kept, as C keeps them.
events.order: lower first, then module id. 10-29: a machine that owns its tracks' increment and takes them; 40-69: tempo and rate changes on other tracks.

subscribers.does: a POLY track's increment becomes its voices' tuning (poly_track_inc) and the DSP runs it at unity; it takes the track
subscribers.evidence: sdk/octabam/modules/poly8/polyphony.s poly_increment_shift; shared-machine-hooks.s mr_rate_hook sends POLY tracks there before any other module's rate_hook

subscribers.does: scales the increment by project tempo over the sample's tempo when REPITCH is on the track, clamped to 2x; d3 holds the sample tempo its rate_gate (0x4000406a) found in the same builder

events.orderEvidence: sdk/octabam/modules/poly8/composition.json replaces Repitch's 0x40004100 detour with POLY8's mr_rate_hook, which takes POLY tracks first and passes the others to rate_hook. POLY8 also forces a POLY track's live TSTR off (poly_config_tstr), so REPITCH never acts on one.

events.when: before stock stops a track's voice and binds it fresh; track 8 or more means every track, and stock then comes back here once per track
events.context: the frame interrupt or a task: short, no firmware call that can block
events.contract: Return 0 to pass. 1 drops this reset: stock does nothing and the call returns. 2 runs stock's reset at once: no later ev_voice_bind handler and no ev_voice_bind_run handler. Any other nonzero acts as 2. d2-d7/a2-a6 are the caller's and must be kept.
events.order: lower first, then module id. 10-29: a machine that renders voices itself and redirects the resets its renderer causes; 30-69: gates on ordinary tracks (mute modes).

subscribers.does: while POLY8 renders an extension voice, the reset stops that voice only (1); while it renders a primary voice, stock's reset runs at once (2)
subscribers.evidence: sdk/octabam/modules/poly8/shared-machine-hooks.s mr_stop_voice; polyphony.s poly_stop_voice, whose .psv_replay goes to stock without fresh_bind while rendering

subscribers.does: in OTFX-T and DT-T a single muted or soloed-out track's reset is dropped, so no new voice starts (a SIDE-CHAIN key track keeps it)

events.orderEvidence: POLY8's mr_stop_voice checks its renderer state before anything else, then Mute Modes' gate (its mr_mute_suppressed, a copy of fresh_bind's test, when fresh_bind is linked), and only then discards the track's extension voices (ev_voice_bind_run).

events.when: every ev_voice_bind handler passed: stock's reset runs next
events.contract: A notification: every handler runs; none can stop the reset. d2-d7/a2-a6 are the caller's and must be kept.

subscribers.does: discards the track's extension voices, held keys and queued presses, interrupts masked

events.orderEvidence: In POLY8 + Mute Modes the extension voices are discarded only when the reset is not dropped (mr_mute_suppressed returns first).
